studies.title: The Cihannüma, printed in Istanbul
studies.caption: İbrahim Müteferrika, founder of the first Ottoman Turkish press, prints Kâtip Çelebi's geography of the world, the Cihannüma, with maps engraved in Istanbul.
studies.prompt: Istanbul printing shop in1732: low side view of an Ottoman printer in plain robe and wrapped headcloth lifting a freshly printed map leaf from a worktable, open bound geography and several drying sheets beyond. A modest wooden handpress in background, paper and ink textures foreground. Small indistinct Ottoman script columns around a period map, no readable fake text. No modern lithographic press, roller factory, enormous illuminated manuscript or tourist mosque skyline.
